description: Defines a data transfer object class 'DataGroupPermissionFilterParams' used for filtering data group permissions based on roles, entities, and other criteria within the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: DataGroupPermissionFilterParams
classes.description: DTO for filtering data group permissions with properties for user roles, data groups, and access flags.

methods.name: getUserRoles
methods.description: Returns the array of UserRole objects assigned to this filter parameter.

methods.name: setUserRoles
methods.description: Sets the array of UserRole objects for this filter parameter.

methods.name: isWithApiDataGroups
methods.description: Returns whether API data groups should be included.

methods.name: setWithApiDataGroups
methods.description: Sets whether API data groups should be included.

methods.name: isOnlyAccessible
methods.description: Indicates if only accessible permissions are to be fetched.

methods.name: getRolesToExclude
methods.description: Returns roles to exclude from filtering.

methods.name: setRolesToExclude
methods.description: Sets roles to exclude from filtering.

methods.name: getRolesToInclude
methods.description: Returns roles to include in filtering.

methods.name: setRolesToInclude
methods.description: Sets roles to include in filtering.

methods.name: getEntities
methods.description: Returns the list of entity identifiers involved in the filter.

methods.name: setEntities
methods.description: Sets the list of entities involved in the filter.

methods.name: getDataGroups
methods.description: Returns data group identifiers for filtering.

methods.name: setDataGroups
methods.description: Sets data group identifiers for filtering.
